_comment: Starting values only. Every one of these is a guess calibrated to the constraints in DESIGN.md. The v0.2 milestone exists to find out which are wrong. All values are exposed as sliders in the debug tuning overlay and hot-reload without a rebuild.

sim._comment: Core loop. Changing tick_hz changes behaviour, not just smoothness — every rate below is per real second and derived from it.

movement._comment: Feel parameters. These cannot be reasoned about, only felt. Expect to change all of them within the first hour on device. Speeds are in tiles per second.

terrain._comment: Nest map is 150x80 tiles. dig_time_base is seconds to fully dig one tile at depth 0; depth multiplier makes deep soil uneconomic rather than impossible — this is the bedrock mechanism.

pheromone._comment: Diffusion is mechanically required, not decorative — gradient following cannot work on a zero-width trail. Half-lives are in seconds. The forage/alarm gap is where the interesting behaviour lives: forage becomes infrastructure, alarm stays an emergency.

colony._comment: Calibrated so a colony grows from 8 to roughly 80 over 40-60 minutes of good foraging, and dies in 20-30 minutes when played badly. food_upkeep is per ant per second and is the single most sensitive number here.

surface._comment: Food respawn drives the whole economy ceiling. If the colony plateaus too low, this is the first number to raise.

worm._comment: Tuned for 4-6 soldiers to kill one, losing 1-2. brood_target_weight is what makes it a threat to the colony rather than a wandering hazard that eats whichever worker was closest.

combat._comment: Only soldiers have these. Workers have no combat values at all — that absence is deliberate and load-bearing.

presentation._comment: The only section game/ may read. sim/ must never touch this. tile_render_size is the tile-to-pixel mapping at 1x zoom, in design pixels at 1920x1080.
